message.content:
A cell that contains more than one nucleus is called a **polynucleated** (or **multinucleated**) cell.  
Examples include:

| Cell type | Typical function | Where you find it |
|-----------|------------------|-------------------|
| **Osteoclast** | Bone resorption | Bone tissue |
| **Skeletal muscle fiber (myocyte)** | Contraction | Skeletal muscle |
| **Syncytium** (e.g., placental trophoblasts) | Nutrient transfer, hormone secretion | Placenta |
| **Schwann cell** (some types) | Myelination of peripheral nerves | Peripheral nervous system |

So if you’re looking for a general term, “polynucleated” or “multinucleated” cell is the right description.
